q: Her success had _____ the faith her teachers had put in her.
explain: justify v. 证明……正当；为……辩解。
translation: 她的成功证明老师们对她的信任是正确的。

q: The main _____ of the heart is to pump blood around the body.
explain: function n. 功能；作用。
translation: 心脏的主要功能是将血液泵送到全身。

q: Despite the power cuts, the hospital continued to _____ normally.
explain: function v. 正常运转；起作用。
translation: 尽管停电，医院仍继续正常运转。

q: The smooth _____ of the machine depends on regular maintenance.
explain: functioning n. 运作；运行。
translation: 机器的平稳运行依赖于定期维护。

q: We now have a fully _____ shower in the bathroom.
explain: functioning adj. 正常工作的。
translation: 我们现在浴室里有一个完全正常工作的淋浴器。

q: Education is a top _____ for the new government.
explain: priority n. 优先事项；首要任务。
translation: 教育是新政府的头等大事。

q: Do you have a _____ history of back problems?
explain: prior adj. 先前的；事先的。
translation: 你以前有过背部问题吗？

q: The group argues that many of the proposed reforms will have _____ consequences.
explain: unintended adj. 非计划中的；意想不到的。
translation: 该团体认为许多拟议的改革将带来意想不到的后果。

q: The defendant claimed he had not _____ to kill his brother.
explain: intend v. 打算；意图。
translation: 被告声称他并非有意杀死自己的兄弟。

q: The book failed to reach its _____ audience.
explain: intended adj. 预期的；打算中的。
translation: 这本书未能触及它预期的读者群。

q: She _____ the kettle with fresh water after boiling it.
explain: refill v. 重新装满；再填满。
translation: 水烧开后，她重新往壶里装满了清水。

q: She wanted to improve her English so she could _____ as a translator.
explain: qualify v. 取得资格；有资格。
translation: 她想提高英语水平，以便能取得翻译资格。

q: She is extremely well _____ for the job, with years of experience.
explain: qualified adj. 合格的；有资格的。
translation: 她完全胜任这份工作，拥有多年经验。

q: Previous teaching experience is a necessary _____ for this job.
explain: qualification n. 资格；资质。
translation: 以往的教学经验是这份工作必需的资格。

q: The president has _____ denied the rumors about his health.
explain: consistently adv. 一贯地；始终如一地。
translation: 总统一直否认有关他健康的传言。

q: The results are entirely _____ with our earlier research.
explain: consistent adj. 一致的；相符的。
translation: 这些结果与我们早先的研究完全一致。

q: Whatever I tell him to do, he does the _____.
explain: opposite n. 相反的人或事物。
translation: 无论我叫他做什么，他都反着来。

q: The medicine had the _____ effect to what the doctor expected.
explain: opposite adj. 相反的；对立的。
translation: 这种药产生了与医生预期相反的效果。

q: She made a _____ to visit her relatives more often.
explain: resolution n. 决心；决定。
translation: 她下决心要更经常地探望亲戚。

q: They have provided a legal system to _____ disputes and regulate trade.
explain: resolve v. 解决；化解。
translation: 他们建立了一个法律体系来解决争端和规范贸易。

q: Recent events strengthened her _____ to find out the truth.
explain: resolve n. 决心；坚定的意志。
translation: 最近发生的事坚定了她查明真相的决心。

q: The time for us to make a decision is _____ close.
explain: draw v. 接近；靠近（draw close）。
translation: 我们做决定的时间越来越近了。

q: Far more resources are needed to improve adult _____.
explain: literacy n. 读写能力。
translation: 提高成人读写能力需要多得多的资源。

q: “The Sun Also Rises” is a classic of American _____.
explain: literature n. 文学；文学作品。
translation: 《太阳照常升起》是美国文学的一部经典作品。

q: It was Chaucer who really turned English into a _____ language.
explain: literary adj. 文学的；文学语言的。
translation: 正是乔叟真正把英语变成了一种文学语言。

q: I am not referring to “small” people in the _____ sense of the word.
explain: literal adj. 字面的；本义的。
translation: 我指的不是这个词字面意义上的“小”人物。

q: I kept the _____, so I can return it if you don't like it.
explain: receipt n. 收据；发票。
translation: 我留了收据，所以如果你不喜欢可以退货。

q: The Empire State Building is a familiar _____ on the New York skyline.
explain: landmark n. 地标；里程碑。
translation: 帝国大厦是纽约天际线上一个为人熟悉的地标。

q: The pilot had to land the plane early because of a sudden _____ in the engine.
explain: malfunction n. 故障，失灵。
translation: 由于发动机突然发生故障，飞行员不得不提前降落飞机。

q: The coffee machine _____ again this morning, so we had to buy drinks outside.
explain: malfunction v. 发生故障，失灵。
translation: 咖啡机今天早上又出故障了，所以我们只好去外面买饮料。

q: The link in that strange email secretly downloaded _____ onto his phone.
explain: malware n. 恶意软件。
translation: 那封奇怪邮件里的链接偷偷把恶意软件下载到了他的手机上。

q: The witness gave an _____ account of what happened that night.
explain: inconsistent adj. 不一致的，前后矛盾的。
translation: 证人对那天晚上发生的事情给出了前后矛盾的描述。

q: Her story has remained _____ from the first interview to the last.
explain: consistent adj. 一致的，始终如一的。
translation: 从第一次面谈到最后一次，她的说法始终一致。

q: I would like to _____ a table for four people at seven o'clock.
explain: reserve v. 预订，保留。
translation: 我想预订一张七点钟四个人的桌子。

q: The country keeps large oil _____ in case of a national emergency.
explain: reserve n. 储备，储藏。
translation: 该国保留了大量石油储备，以备国家紧急情况之需。

q: His total earnings are said to _____ to over three hundred thousand dollars a year.
explain: amount v. 总计，等于（amount to）。
translation: 据说他的总收入每年总计超过三十万美元。

q: The unexpected bad news did not _____ her enthusiasm for the project.
explain: dampen v. 使减弱，抑制；弄湿。
translation: 这个意外的坏消息并没有减弱她对这个项目的热情。

q: The walls of the old cottage felt cold and _____ after the long rain.
explain: damp adj. 潮湿的。
translation: 长时间下雨后，那座老屋的墙壁摸起来又冷又潮湿。

q: The new policy is expected to have a significant _____ on small businesses.
explain: impact n. 影响，冲击。
translation: 预计这项新政策将对小企业产生重大影响。

q: The sudden rise in fuel prices _____ heavily on the company's transport costs.
explain: impact v. 影响，对……产生冲击。
translation: 燃料价格突然上涨严重影响了该公司的运输成本。

q: Small local shops can still _____ if they offer something that large chains do not.
explain: thrive v. 茁壮成长，兴旺。
translation: 如果小商店能提供大型连锁店没有的东西，它们仍然可以兴旺发展。

q: The rise of the online market was _____ with the decline of many town-center stores.
explain: coincident adj. 同时发生的，一致的。
translation: 线上市场的兴起与许多市中心商店的衰落是同时发生的。

q: _____, they had both chosen the same topic for their final presentation.
explain: coincidentally adv. 碰巧地，巧合地。
translation: 碰巧的是，他们俩都选了同一个题目作为期末展示。

q: She felt a deep sense of _____ about leaving her younger brother alone at home.
explain: guilt n. 内疚，罪恶感；罪行。
translation: 她把弟弟一个人留在家里，心里深感内疚。

q: He felt _____ about not telling his parents the truth about the accident.
explain: guilty adj. 内疚的；有罪的。
translation: 他因为没有把事故的真相告诉父母而感到内疚。

q: His _____ with winning every game began to affect his relationships with friends.
explain: obsession n. 痴迷，困扰。
translation: 他对每场比赛都要赢的痴迷开始影响他和朋友们的关系。

q: She has become increasingly _____ about keeping the kitchen perfectly clean.
explain: obsessive adj. 过分痴迷的，执着的。
translation: 她对保持厨房一尘不染越来越过分痴迷。

q: He has been _____ with old sports cars since he was a teenager.
explain: obsessed adj. 着迷的，迷恋的。
translation: 他从十几岁起就对老爷跑车着迷。

q: What started as a small complaint quickly _____ into a major public argument.
explain: snowball v. 迅速扩大，滚雪球般增长。
translation: 起初只是一个小小的抱怨，很快就滚雪球般演变成了一场公开的激烈争论。

q: This German word has no exact _____ in English, so it is hard to translate.
explain: equivalent n. 等同物，对应物。
translation: 这个德语词在英语中没有完全对应的词，所以很难翻译。

q: The lawyer asked the witness to focus only on facts that were _____ to the case.
explain: relevant adj. 相关的，切题的。
translation: 律师要求证人只关注与案件相关的事实。

q: That company has held a _____ position in the software market for over a decade.
explain: dominant adj. 占主导地位的，支配的。
translation: 那家公司在软件市场占据主导地位已经超过十年了。

q: Teachers say they need more _____ to decide how to teach in their own classrooms.
explain: autonomy n. 自主权，自治。
translation: 教师们说他们需要更多的自主权来决定在自己课堂上如何教学。

q: The success of their first album helped _____ their position as a leading rock band.
explain: solidify v. 巩固，使凝固。
translation: 首张专辑的成功帮助他们巩固了作为顶尖摇滚乐队的地位。

q: I looked at the price _____ and decided the jacket was too expensive for me.
explain: tag n. 标签（price tag：价格标签；代价）。
translation: 我看了看价格标签，觉得那件夹克对我来说太贵了。

q: The government has introduced new laws to _____ the activities of credit companies.
explain: regulate v. 管理，控制，调节。
translation: 政府出台了新法律来规范信贷公司的活动。

q: When the actor raised his hand, it was the _____ for the music to begin.
explain: cue n. 提示，暗示。
translation: 当演员举起手时，那就是音乐开始的提示。

q: The country experienced a period of _____ economic growth throughout the 1990s.
explain: sustained adj. 持续的，持久的。
translation: 该国在20世纪90年代经历了一段持续的经济增长期。

q: It is difficult to _____ the children's interest in the lesson for more than twenty minutes.
explain: sustain v. 维持，支撑。
translation: 要让孩子们对这节课的兴趣维持超过二十分钟是很困难的。

q: The judge said the punishment would _____ as a warning to others.
explain: serve v. 作为；起…作用。
translation: 法官说这一惩罚将作为对其他人的警告。

q: Her first _____ was too powerful for her opponent to return.
explain: serve n. 发球。
translation: 她的第一次发球力量太大，对手无法接回。

q: The river has fallen to its lowest _____ since 2012.
explain: level n. 水平；程度；数量。
translation: 这条河的水位已降至2012年以来的最低水平。

q: Make sure the table is _____ before you start painting.
explain: level adj. 平的；水平的。
translation: 开始上漆前要确保桌子是平的。

q: The workers used machines to _____ the ground before building.
explain: level v. 使平坦。
translation: 工人们在建造前用机器把地面弄平。

q: Rescue planes are trying to _____ the missing sailors.
explain: locate v. 找出…的准确位置；确定…的位置。
translation: 救援飞机正试图确定失踪船员的位置。

q: The room _____ about five meters wide and four meters long.
explain: measure v. 测量出来是（某尺寸、长度、数量等）。
translation: 这个房间量得大约五米宽、四米长。

q: The school has taken new _____ to keep students safe.
explain: measure n. 措施。
translation: 学校采取了新措施来保障学生安全。

q: More than a hundred firemen are still trying to _____ the fire at the plant.
explain: contain v. 控制；防止…蔓延。
translation: 一百多名消防员仍在努力控制工厂的火势。

q: He tried to talk _____ with his team about the problem.
explain: constructively adv. 建设性地；以有助益的方式。
translation: 他试图就这个问题与团队进行建设性的交谈。

q: She gave me some _____ advice on how to improve my writing.
explain: constructive adj. 建设性的；有助益的。
translation: 她就如何改进我的写作给了我一些建设性的建议。

q: Try to stay _____ while driving at night.
explain: alert adj. 警觉的；机敏的。
translation: 夜间开车时要尽量保持警觉。

q: The fire alarm sent an _____ to every room in the building.
explain: alert n. 警报。
translation: 火警警报向大楼里的每个房间发出了警报。

q: The nurse _____ the doctor when the patient's condition changed.
explain: alert v. 提醒；使警觉。
translation: 病人情况发生变化时，护士提醒了医生。

q: Toys with _____ edges are not suitable for young children.
explain: sharp adj. 锋利的；尖锐的。
translation: 有锋利边缘的玩具不适合幼儿。

q: Please make sure you are here at eight o'clock _____.
explain: sharp adv. 准时地；整。
translation: 请确保你八点整到这里。

q: The piece has a _____ in the second bar.
explain: sharp n. 升号。
translation: 这首曲子第二小节有一个升号。

q: He bought extra food in _____ of more people coming than he'd invited.
explain: anticipation n. 预期；预料；期待。
translation: 他多买了食物，预料来的人会比邀请的多。

q: We did not _____ so many people coming to the meeting.
explain: anticipate v. 预期；预料。
translation: 我们没有预料到会有这么多人来开会。

q: The next version of the software will have the _____ over its competitors.
explain: edge n. 优势；有利条件。
translation: 下一个版本的软件将比竞争对手更有优势。

q: She _____ slowly toward the door while no one was looking.
explain: edge v. 缓慢移动。
translation: 没人看的时候，她慢慢向门口挪去。
